system.description: Beginning exactly one hour before sunrise, the thaumaturge smears herself with the blood of a twelve-hour-old corpse and stands motionless facing east; if performed correctly, she turns to stone as sunlight strikes her, becoming immune to physical damage, flame and heat (short of molten rock) while mentally dormant. She wakes 10 minutes after the following sunset by spending an additional Blood Trait; any error in the ritual risks true death.
